title: FlipContent configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.FlipContentAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

FlipSelf.description: Flips the content when it is clicked; otherwise flipping happens only through the API.

IsFlipped.description: Starts with the back face visible.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
